text:
incidentbot: PagerDuty alert fired -> PD-9342
incidentbot: severity=P1, source=autopager, target=host-gpu-42 (rack-r5u3), symptom=kernel oops followed by kubelet NotReady, current ack=none
devon: acked the PD, I'm on it. pulling serial now.
sara: just saw the autopager. checking console - serial logs show repeated oops + watchdog, might be GPU driver hard hang. attaching tail of serial:
```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: GPU at 0000:3b:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[ 1234.568012] kernel: kernel panic - not syncing: Watchdog detected hard lockup
[ 1234.568345] reboot: Restarting system
```
maria: kubelet report shows last heartbeat 30s ago, pods on host are Evicted/Unknown. Running `kubectl get nodes host-gpu-42 -o wide` now to confirm.
ops-bot: kubectl output: NODE STATUS: host-gpu-42 NotReady 15m kubelet, AGE 47d
devon: confirming customer impact - which tenants were scheduled on this host? checking placement svc.
sara: quick check: two inference tenants (team-alpha-prod, search-embed) had pods on this host but replicas exist on other nodes. ingress shows slight 504 spike for alpha around 1736504200.
devon: ok so partial impact, retries likely kept p99 under control but cost/latency bumped. notifying support to watch for error pages. @maria are there ongoing RMA steps or do we try soft reboot first?
maria: I triggered a graceful drain earlier but kubelet died mid-drain. serial suggests repeated kernel panic; soft reboot attempted by BMC didn't succeed - host is cycling. I'll open a ticket with colo for physical RMA if it doesn't come up in 10 minutes.
ada: (typo) -> ada: taking telemetry, running `ipmitool -I lanplus -H bmc.r5u3.example -U admin -P **** power status` from ops jumpbox.
ops-bot: IPMI returned: chassis power: on; last reset cause: watchdog
sara: trying to force a kernel log copy before host fully reboots: pulled journalctl via node-exporter snapshot: snippet:
```
-- Logs begin at Tue 2026-03-14 10:11:12 UTC, end at Tue 2026-03-14 10:25:03 UTC --
Mar 14 10:23:59 host-gpu-42 kernel: BUG: unable to handle kernel NULL pointer dereference at 0000000000000008
Mar 14 10:24:00 host-gpu-42 kernel: Modules linked in: nvidia_uvm nvidia_modeset nvidia
Mar 14 10:24:00 host-gpu-42 kernel: RIP: 0010:some_driver_fn+0x1f4/0x400
```
devon: thanks. I'll escalate to infra-rt for driver regressions. tagging @infra-rt and @platform-ml.
incidentbot: escalation note appended to PD-9342: channel=infra-rt, severity stays P1.
maria: customer-impact assessment: brief transient 504s for team-alpha-prod (0.8% traffic) and search-embed had 5 minute error spike. No persistent data loss; autoscaling recovered most pods within 2 minutes.
ada -> ada: drafting a short blameless incident note for support. Will include timeline and mitigation steps.
ada -> ada: quick check: any correlated alerts from NMS or power systems in rack? none in last hour.
devon: mitigations taken: failing host cordoned, failed pods rescheduled, temporary traffic reroute applied for alpha with weight shift 10% -> 0% to fallback pool.
sara: will open a follow-up ticket with model team to consider lowering single-node placement affinity for that tenant. Might reduce future blast radius.
maria: BMC shows serial output stopped at reboot loop; raised RMA with colo under ticket COLO-7891. ETA tech on site 3h. if host cycles into stable kernel we will cancel RMA.
devon: handing off to night oncall: @ada you'll take monitoring for the next 3h; I'll coordinate RMA follow-through in morning. please escalate to oncall-manager if host doesn't recover in 2h.
ada: taking it. subscribed PD-9342, set a monitor to escalate if kubelet not ready > 15m. updating thread with any console changes.
maria: before handoff: P0->P1 degrade: keeping record as P1 for now because auto-failover mitigated customer-visible impact. Ops note: do not accept auto-provisioning back onto same host until driver patch validated.
devon: adding runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/gpu-node-recovery - follow serial capture -> kernel oops -> force-evac -> RMA path.
incidentbot: PD-9342 updated: ack=devon, escalated=infra-rt, watchlist added: ada,maria,sara. closing autopager thread in 10m if no new events.
ada: noted. I'll post updates here as they happen. :thumbsup:
